content.markdown:
**V1.5.9** of *[Stormworks: Build and Rescue](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Stormworks:_Build_and_Rescue)* was released on August 26th, 2022.

## V1.5.9

- Feature - [#2486](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/2486) [#2712](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/2712) Manual pump, crank and valve
- Feature - [#8074](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/8074) Add keyboard binding support for vehicle editor
- Rework - [#12436](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/12436) Improved steam piston code for a smoother and more consistent behaviour
- Rework - [#12441](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/12441) Steam Piston now outputs the cam rotation instead of extension factor so stroke direction can be determined
- Rework - Starting weather state is now more heavily affected by world seed
- Fix - [#8934](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/8934) Fix tick delay consistency issue with Up/Down gate
- Fix - Players receiving healing when disconnecting from the server from a previously used medkit
- Fix - [#11620](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/11620) Fixed setVehiclePos not failing when passed nan values, adjusted processing for safe teleport (fix will only apply to new saves)
- Fix - [#11835](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/11835) Suspension labelling mistake
- Fix - [#11851](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/11851) Increased size of wheel colliders to better fit visually (old wheels sink into floor less)
- Fix - [#11993](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/11993) Seats not showing Trigger label if there is no labelled hotkey or axis
- Fix - [#12091](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/12091) Terminal Endo Hole in map
- Fix - [#12865](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/12865) Body armour double names
- Fix - [#12918](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/12918) Moved several non-sensor components out of the sensor category

## Source

- [Steam Community News](https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/573090/view/3227412906480370153?l=english)
